Shift Calendar Maker

Build a monthly shift rota from a rotation pattern (e.g. DDNNOOOO for 2 days, 2 nights, 4 off): color-coded calendar, shift totals and print view.

■ Day  ■ Night  ■ Off

📖 How to use

  1. Type your rotation pattern with D = day shift, N = night shift, O = off (e.g. DDNNOOOO).
  2. Pick the month and the date your current cycle starts (day 1 of the pattern).
  3. Press Generate to render the color-coded month calendar with shift totals.
  4. Use Print for a clean paper copy of the rota.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I write the pattern?

One letter per day in cycle order: D day, N night, O off. 'DDNNOOOO' means 2 day shifts, 2 night shifts, then 4 days off, repeating. Letters are case-insensitive.

What does 'cycle starts' mean?

The date on which day 1 of your pattern falls. If today you are on the second night of DDNNOOOO, set the start date 2 days earlier so the pattern lines up.

Can I print the calendar?

Yes — the Print button produces a clean black-and-white-friendly layout of the current month.
